outcome: white blood cell count (total WBC, neutrophils, lymphocytes, eosinophils, basophils, monocytes)
finding: Significant changes in white blood cell counts occur during pregnancy, persisting until delivery and resolving to pre-pregnancy levels by 21 days postpartum, with substantial differences observed between cell subtypes.
mod_finding: Total WBC count was significantly elevated from the first day after birth, regardless of delivery mode.
